## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit format in title
- [ ] DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed (runbook, API, ADR)

- [ ] No new TODOs without tracking note in `docs/`
